## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the [DCO](../DCO).
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing, and `go vet ./...` and `make test` pass.
- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] New source files carry the copyright and SPDX header.
- [ ] `make notices` was run, if dependencies changed.
